title: Si-Clauses & Mixed Conditions
goal: Control real, hypothetical and mixed si-clauses accurately when managing risks and deadlines
grammar: si-clauses & hypothetical-structures at C1: real warnings, hypotheticals and mixed past-to-present conditions

items: I can form real *si*-clause warnings with the indicative and never put the present subjunctive or conditional after *si*.
I can use *si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional for hypothetical risks and backups.
I can link a past counterfactual condition (*si* + pluperfect subjunctive) to a present result in a mixed conditional.
